featured_reviews.name: Gayatri Lele
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience ever.
This courier service is very bad as far as handling the customers is concerned.
I had ordered some handmade stuff worth Rs. 2000 from Malad. Two packets were supposed to come through this courier service. The parcel was delivered but there was only one package. We asked for the other one, but the delivery boy said he is carrying only one packet. We thought it might be delivered later on.
However, when we checked next day,  their online tracking was showing the status as delivered, for both the packages.

We tried enquiring , but the Anjani Courier service people started putting a blame on us stating that we have signed for two packages. This was not the case. Instead of searching in their own service centre, these people have started a blame game on us, as if we are the thieves. This is not at all done.

They were contacting us from Malad and that Malad branch has no contact with Kalamboli branch. We got a call from Kalamboli centre after a week of pursuing this matter with the person in Malad. This clearly shows that they lack coordination, which is highly dangerous.

This package was really near to my heart. I wanted it to gift it to some of the close relatives. Now everything is lost because of this shabby courier service. BTW, they had promised to send someone for enquiry, but nobody arrived.

Moreover, their staff is so rude and they don't let you complete even a single sentence.

Do not ever go to them for any kind of business!!!!
